snippets.title: Collections: Counter
snippets.context: Counter is a specialized dictionary for counting hashable objects.
snippets.codeSnippet:
from collections import Counter
words = ['apple', 'orange', 'apple']
counts = Counter(words)
print(counts.most_common(1))

Properties: Getter/Setter
Dunder Methods: __str__
Itertools: Cycle
snippets.codeSnippet:
from itertools import cycle
colors = cycle(['red', 'blue'])

    print(next(colors))

snippets.title: Closures: State Tracking
snippets.codeSnippet:
def make_counter():
    count = 0
    def counter():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return count
    return counter

snippets.title: Args/Kwargs: Proxying
Map/Filter: Functional
snippets.description: Use map and filter with lambda.

evens = filter(lambda x: x % 2 == 0, nums)
squares = map(lambda x: x * x, nums)
